verification_report.summary: Correct. Under the accepted internal inputs, the proof establishes existence, unbounded residual rigidity, the separate dimension-one conclusion, and the ordinary-type scalar/regularity statement. The L1 divisorial-removal remainder is a genuine Omega-psh potential; intrinsic locality and pluripolar vanishing transfer its extended Monge–Ampère inequality. Smooth dual threshold rigidity applies in dimensions at least two, while current domination plus Stokes settles dimension one. Bounded strict domination excludes c'<c, c'>c, and c'=0.
